articles.title: Brazil sees record fall in Amazon deforestation as key election looms
articles.description: The Amazon rainforest is a crucial buffer against climate change - but deforestation had expanded under former president Jair Bolsonaro.

articles.title: Trump waives several Russia sanctions as row with Zelensky intensifies
articles.description: The US president temporarily ends many restrictions on Moscow recently passed by Congress over "national security" concerns.

articles.title: Oregon teacher fought school attacker before armed dad shot suspect 'multiple times'
articles.description: The 16-year-old suspect previously attended the primary school and had targeted a special educational needs classroom, police say.

articles.title: Palestinians and US journalist injured by Israeli settlers in West Bank harvest attack
articles.description: The BBC sees masked settlers attack Palestinians trying to harvest olives, amid a surge in similar incidents.

articles.title: Ship attack reports near Hormuz reach record high as oil exports slow
articles.description: BBC Verify analysis of data from a UK maritime agency shows 12 vessels were struck in a week.

articles.title: Trump calls off livestream of Fort Hood attacker's execution by firing squad
articles.description: Trump said some would "rather not watch" the killing of Nidal Hasan, the first military execution in over 60 years.

articles.title: Tip-off foiled US teen suspect's plot to attack Hindu temple, police say
articles.description: The alleged plot only failed because the 19-year-old suspect's gun jammed outside the place of worship, say police.
